name: 在 PhotoCraft 中编辑
tagline: 无需导出图片，一键用 PhotoCraft 编辑 Figma 中的图片，保存后自动同步。
description: 无需导出图片，一键用 PhotoCraft 编辑 Figma 中的图片，保存后自动同步。
review_notes: The companion runs only on loopback, creates/reads local PSD files, and launches PhotoCraft. All Figma document changes use the official Plugin API. The companion does not inject into, modify, or automate Figma Web/Desktop. Local HTTP uses a per-installation pairing token. No analytics or remote image processing are implemented. The public plugin does not use private Figma APIs.
